info.title: Simulated Astronaut Inputs API
info.description: Proposed local-only retrieval contract derived from Simulated-Astronaut-Inputs-Contract.md and simulated-astronaut-inputs.schema.json. Clinical reference bands are not input validation bounds. Run creation and playback controls are out of scope. Authentication transport is intentionally unresolved; configure a local security scheme before protected deployment.

servers.description: Same-origin onboard deployment; no Earth service required.

tags.name: Simulation
tags.description: Read simulated observations from persisted local runs.

get.description:
Read-only retrieval of observations already produced by a local run. GET must not advance simulation time, create runs, generate random samples, or modify observations. Results sort by (observed_at, record_id) ascending. Pagination freezes the first-page snapshot, preventing omissions or duplicates during playback. Start a new request without a cursor to see newly generated observations. Unsupported query parameters return 422.

All 20 indicator keys are required. Valid means usable data, not healthy. Abnormal but well-formed values are returned without diagnoses or severity classifications. Missing values must not become zero. Retained readings preserve original observation timestamps. Freshness is evaluated against simulation_time using indicator-specific configuration.

Daily aggregates use a completed UTC day [00:00:00Z, next 00:00:00Z). Implementations must enforce start < end <= metric observed_at <= record observed_at <= simulation_time, in addition to schema validation. All item astronaut_id values must match the path; response run_id must match the path. record_id is unique within a run. Radiation is a rate, not cumulative dose. Gravity and Earth latency are context; do not infer gravity from mission destination.

All operation dependencies, including authorization when enabled, run locally. Authentication transport remains a deployment decision, so no security scheme is asserted in this base contract. Deployments enabling authorization must add the selected local scheme and operation security requirement, restrict access to the astronaut, and use the documented 401/403 responses. Absence of a security scheme here is not an authorization bypass requirement.

parameters.name: run_id
parameters.description: Persisted local run with fixed scenario configuration.

parameters.name: astronaut_id
parameters.description: Astronaut configured in the requested run.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive lower observation-time bound. UTC RFC 3339 timestamp ending in Z.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Exclusive upper observation-time bound. Must be later than from when both are supplied. UTC RFC 3339 timestamp ending in Z.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum page size. Keep unchanged when using a continuation cursor.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque continuation token. Retains the first-page snapshot. Keep run, astronaut and all other query parameters identical. Omit to start a new snapshot.

200.description: Ordered page of immutable simulated observations. An empty match returns items=[] and next_cursor=null.

sample.summary: Workbook values with synthetic run metadata and explicitly assigned daily periods.

empty.summary: Known run and astronaut with no matching observations.

400.description: Invalid cursor or cursor parameters do not match.

error.message: Invalid cursor or cursor parameters do not match.

401.description: Missing or invalid local credentials when authorization is enabled.

error.message: Missing or invalid local credentials when authorization is enabled.

403.description: Caller cannot access the requested astronaut.

error.message: Caller cannot access the requested astronaut.

404.description: Unknown run or astronaut not configured in the run.

error.message: Unknown run or astronaut not configured in the run.
Unknown run or astronaut not configured in the run.

410.description: Snapshot expired; restart pagination without a cursor.

error.message: Snapshot expired; restart pagination without a cursor.

422.description: Invalid timestamp, range, limit, or unsupported query parameter.

error.message: Invalid timestamp, range, limit, or unsupported query parameter.

503.description: Local simulation storage cannot be read.

error.message: Local simulation storage cannot be read.

get.x-authentication-status: Deployment-specific local authentication; transport not selected.
